audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 3 and 6 were marked Skill and 2+ items was marked Darius, while every why on the page says Darius owns 3 and 6 ('By level 3 E Apprehend pins him for a full uncontested combo', 'Level 6 your all-in beats his fragile mid-R window') and that K'Sante owns the late game ('Late, full tank stats plus R All Out repositioning outscale your execute').
audit.why: 55.22% over 2997 games is one of the strongest Darius lanes in the pool, and the prose, the packet's derived chart and the win rate all agree the lane is Darius's until K'Sante finishes tank items. Nothing at level 3 or 6 is a coin flip: Ntofo Strikes needs two stacks to pull, and All Out does not exist at 3.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group: win[2] and phases[2] to Darius 6.5/10, win[4] to Darius, win[6] and phases[6] to K'Sante 4/10, with the three whys rewritten. champ-data/ksante.full.js needs the inverse.

audit.whatIsWrong: All Out was tracked everywhere with no cooldown, and report[0].t said the shockwave comes off 'his third Q'.
audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80s - baiting it at rank 1 buys two minutes. Ntofo Strikes fires its pulling shockwave at TWO stacks, not three, and is only 3.5s base, so the pull returns far faster than players expect. Path Maker is 14/13/12/11/10s and Footwork 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s.
audit.corrected: report[0].t, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[9].t, spikes[1].text, whys[4] and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the real numbers and the two-stack rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5].t was a stub. dosFull[0].t and dontsFull[0].t both described the Q as a wall-knockup, which is not what it does, and nothing said what Path Maker's charge actually gives him.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes slows and, at two stacks, pulls - the wall-launch belongs to All Out, which knocks you back through any wall in the path and then dashes after you, which is exactly how he displaces you out of Noxian Guillotine's 460 range. Path Maker takes reduced damage for the whole charge-up, so damage poured into it is wasted; and while he is All Out, Path Maker no longer knocks back or stuns at all.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, dosFull[0].t, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten around the real behaviour.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere despite All Out granting him healing.
audit.why: The _missing file flags needs-antiheal on All Out, and All Out is exactly the phase where your bleed has to out-pace his sustain.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now buys Executioner's ahead of his ult timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.difficulty said 7.5/10 and breakdown.carry said 7.5/10 while diffRating, carryRating and report[14].t all say 5.5/10 and 6/10.
audit.why: Three fields on the same page disagreed about the same two numbers. The enum fields and the final rating line agree with each other, so the two breakdown strings are the outliers.
audit.corrected: breakdown.difficulty and breakdown.carry brought into line with 5.5/10 and 6/10.
